name: Sun Cleric: Fortuitous doesn't flicker on and off near the 80% health threshold (#5763, #5783)
contract: AscensionSunCleric.cpp's Refresh(Player*) is driven every 500ms by sun_cleric_player::OnPlayerUpdate and computed `bool healthy = player->GetHealthPct() > 80` with no hysteresis, then called SetHelper(player, 561396, healthy && player->HasAura(561328)) for the Fortuitous talent 561328 / helper 561396. Any health value hovering near 80% in combat (healing ticks, DoTs) toggled the helper on and off every refresh (#5763 'blinks on and off', #5783's Glare action-button flashing is the same toggle). PR #1460 proposed fixing this with a new native AuraStateType 28 shared across five CoA spells and touching SharedDefines.h/Unit.cpp/Player.cpp/Pet.cpp; it was closed unmerged (no review comments) and was untested (no build, no scenario run) and out of scope for only these two Fortuitous reports. The fix instead adds a local hysteresis band to Refresh() alone: state.healthyAbove80 turns on above 80% and only turns back off at or below 75%, so a dip to 76-80% while already 'healthy' leaves Fortuitous applied. This scenario proves that a dip into the dead band (78%) keeps the helper applied, that a genuine drop out of the band (70%) clears it, and that climbing back above 80% re-applies it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: above 80% health, Fortuitous is applied
SETUP: health is at 78%, inside the dead band
Health is still inside the dead band when the helper is read
A dip to 78% (inside the 75-80% dead band) does not clear Fortuitous
Dropping to 70% (outside the dead band) clears Fortuitous
